title: Best self improvement app
body: I’m not gonna lie I deleted this app and tried to tell myself I didn’t need it to improve my life but the reminders and gorgeous design really go a long way in motivating me toward a better me. Carefully scripted readings and inspiring challenges turn self care into a can do operation I redownloaded it and I’m never leaving
author: khaleesi246

title: I like it
body: I like it, I’m only four days in and it’s going great
